messages.subject: Executive application | Advanced manufacturing, ESG and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear KCE Electronics Recruitment Team,

I am submitting my executive profile through KCE’s published recruitment channel after my earlier note to an individual address was rejected by my email provider before delivery.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination, strategic partnerships and executive stakeholder strategy across a major industrial operation.

KCE’s advanced manufacturing platform aligns well with my experience coordinating regulators, public institutions, communities, contractors and internal business teams around complex investment and sustainability priorities. My recent work also includes stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, together with carbon-data readiness and executive issue management.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional mandates across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, ESG, Strategic Partnerships or Country Leadership. I am internationally mobile and available following a 30-day notice period.

My attached CV is tailored to KCE Electronics. I would value a confidential discussion with the relevant senior HR or business leader.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
